extras.name: Accurate
extras.summary: +2 to attack checks with the effect per rank.

extras.name: Affects Corporeal
extras.summary: Lets an incorporeal user's effect work on corporeal targets at a rank equal to extra ranks.

extras.name: Affects Insubstantial
extras.summary: Effect also works on insubstantial targets at half (1 point) or full (2 points) rank.

extras.name: Affects Objects
extras.summary: Fortitude-resisted effect also works on objects (+1), or only on objects (+0).

extras.name: Affects Others
extras.summary: Grant a personal effect to others by touch (+1), or to others only (+0).

extras.name: Alternate Effect
extras.summary: Adds an alternate setting to a power's array; Dynamic versions can share points.

extras.name: Alternate Resistance
extras.summary: Effect is resisted by a different defense: +1 if easier to beat, +0 if equivalent.

extras.name: Area
extras.summary: Effect fills an area shape instead of needing an attack; each extra +1 doubles area distance.

extras.name: Attack
extras.summary: Turns a personal effect into a close attack used on others (e.g. Teleport Attack).

extras.name: Contagious
extras.summary: Effect spreads to anyone who touches an affected target.

extras.name: Dimensional
extras.summary: Effect reaches into one dimension (1), a related group (2), or any dimension (3).

extras.name: Extended Range
extras.summary: Doubles all range increments of a ranged effect per rank.

extras.name: Feature
extras.summary: Adds a minor extra capability to the effect per rank.

extras.name: Homing
extras.summary: A missed ranged attack tries again next turn; one extra attempt per rank.

extras.name: Impervious
extras.summary: Defense ignores effects whose rank is half the Impervious rank (rounded up) or less.

extras.name: Increased Duration
extras.summary: Raises duration one step: instant to concentration, concentration to sustained, sustained to continuous.

extras.name: Increased Mass
extras.summary: Adds 1 to the mass rank an effect (e.g. Teleport) can carry per rank.

extras.name: Increased Range
extras.summary: Raises range one step: close to ranged, ranged to perception (close-to-perception is +2).

extras.name: Incurable
extras.summary: Healing and Regeneration cannot remove the effect's results (unless Persistent).

extras.name: Indirect
extras.summary: Ranged effect originates from a point other than the user, ignoring intervening cover (1-4 ranks).

extras.name: Innate
extras.summary: Effect is an inborn trait and cannot be Nullified.

extras.name: Insidious
extras.summary: Results of the effect are hard to detect (DC 20 check or unusual sense).

extras.name: Linked
extras.summary: Two or more effects always work together as one action; costs simply add up.

extras.name: Multiattack
extras.summary: Hit multiple targets, or one target several times for a higher resistance DC.

extras.name: Penetrating
extras.summary: Overcomes Impervious defenses up to the Penetrating rank (max effect rank).

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Effect can perform delicate, fine-control tasks.

extras.name: Reach
extras.summary: Extends a close effect's reach by 5 feet per rank.

extras.name: Reaction
extras.summary: Effect triggers automatically as a reaction: +1 from a free action, +3 from a standard action.

extras.name: Reversible
extras.summary: You can undo the effect's results at will as a free action.

extras.name: Ricochet
extras.summary: Bounce an attack off surfaces to change direction, one bounce per rank.

extras.name: Secondary Effect
extras.summary: Instant effect hits the target again on the following round.

extras.name: Selective
extras.summary: Choose who is and is not affected, mainly for area effects.

extras.name: Sleep
extras.summary: Effect leaves targets asleep instead of incapacitated.

extras.name: Split
extras.summary: Divide a single-target effect's ranks among an extra target per rank.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.summary: Effect is hard to notice (1 point, DC 20 Perception) or undetectable (2 points).

extras.name: Sustained
extras.summary: Turns a permanent effect into a sustained one (usable with extra effort).

extras.name: Triggered
extras.summary: Set an instant effect to go off later under chosen circumstances; one use per rank.

extras.name: Variable Descriptor
extras.summary: Change the effect's descriptors within a closely related (1) or broad (2) group.

extras.name: Ammunition
extras.summary: The power effect to which this extra is applied is meant to represent a special form of ammunition that cannot be effectively used on its own.

extras.name: Combo Element
extras.summary: If the Combo Element's power works successfully against its target, you are granted a certain number of Combo Points (pg 87) towards performing a Combo Finish.

extras.name: Conductor
extras.summary: Designate a medium through which the Close power can be transmitted.

extras.name: Diminishing Counter
extras.summary: Even if your power proves too weak to counter another power completely, it still provides a small degree of protection by sapping the energy from the other power.

extras.name: Improved Counter
extras.summary: Aside from any contrary descriptor the Gamemaster may rule the power's descriptor naturally counters (light versus dark, for instance), choose an additional descriptor per rank of this extra that the power may counter.

extras.name: Overwhelming Counter
extras.summary: When you successfully counter a power, your own power may overwhelm the other, causing the excess energy to surge towards the attacker.

extras.name: Partial Resistance
extras.summary: A successful resistance check against the effect that does not obtain at least two degrees of success is not wholly effective.

extras.name: Pinball
extras.summary: Unlike normal, each "bounce" of an effect with the ricochet extra inflicts that effect upon whatever it is bouncing off.

extras.name: Potent
extras.summary: This extra may only be applied to effects with Parry, Dodge, Fortitude, or Will resistance checks.

extras.name: Proficient
extras.summary: Each rank of this power extra grants you a +2 bonus to the effect's power checks.

extras.name: Recoverable
extras.summary: An effect with the Ricochet extra that is considered recoverable, such as when throwing a shield or melee weapon, allows any remaining bounces after the attack is made against the intended target to set the attack upon a return...

extras.name: Stacking
extras.summary: This extra allows a power with lingering effects, such as those with a duration of Concentration, Sustained, or Continuous, to use additional applications of the power to increase its resistance DC.

flaws.name: Activation
flaws.summary: Power needs a move (-1) or standard (-2) action to switch on before its effects work.

flaws.name: Check Required
flaws.summary: Must pass a check (DC 10 + flaw ranks) to use the effect.

flaws.name: Concentration
flaws.summary: Sustained effect becomes concentration duration (standard action to maintain).

flaws.name: Diminished Range
flaws.summary: Shrinks the effect's short/medium/long range increments per rank (max 3).

flaws.name: Distracting
flaws.summary: You are vulnerable until your next turn after using the effect.

flaws.name: Fades
flaws.summary: Effect loses 1 rank per use until recovered.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.summary: You take damage when the effect's physical manifestation is damaged.

flaws.name: Grab-Based
flaws.summary: Effect only works after a successful grab.

flaws.name: Inaccurate
flaws.summary: -2 to attack checks with the effect per rank.

flaws.name: Increased Action
flaws.summary: Each step up in required action (free to move to standard...) is -1 per rank.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.summary: Effect works only in certain situations or on certain things (about half usefulness).

flaws.name: Noticeable
flaws.summary: A continuous or permanent effect has an obvious display.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: Continuous effect becomes permanent: always on, no extra effort.

flaws.name: Quirk
flaws.summary: A minor nuisance attached to the effect, the opposite of a Feature.

flaws.name: Reduced Range
flaws.summary: Lowers range one step per rank (perception to ranged to close).

flaws.name: Removable
flaws.summary: Power can be taken away: -1 per 5 points of final cost, or -2 per 5 if Easily Removable (Indestructible reduces the flaw by 1 flat).

flaws.name: Resistible
flaws.summary: Effect gains a (or an additional) resistance check of a chosen defense.

flaws.name: Sense-Dependent
flaws.summary: Target must perceive the effect with a chosen sense for it to work (Dodge to avert).

flaws.name: Side Effect
flaws.summary: Failing with the effect (-1) or using it at all (-2) causes you a problem.

flaws.name: Tiring
flaws.summary: Using the effect leaves you fatigued.

flaws.name: Uncontrolled
flaws.summary: The GM, not you, decides when and how the effect works.

flaws.name: Unreliable
flaws.summary: Effect fails on a d20 roll of 10 or less (or has only five uses).

flaws.name: Announcement
flaws.summary: An effect with this flaw has a colorful name, like "Demon Fist of Oblivion" or "Sacred Mountain Fire Blade," and you are expected to shout it aloud when you use it.

flaws.name: Bad Bounce
flaws.summary: Each "bounce" of an effect with the Ricochet extra requires its own attack or power check (as appropriate to the ricocheting effect) to strike the surface so the effect will change direction as desired.

flaws.name: Calling
flaws.summary: Instead of appearing beside the summoner, a summoned minion hearkens to the summoner's call and must travel from its current location.

flaws.name: Chained
flaws.summary: Your power depends on the success of another action to activate.

flaws.name: Diluted
flaws.summary: This flaw may only be applied to effects with Parry, Dodge, Fortitude, or Will resistance checks.

flaws.name: Dulled
flaws.summary: When subject to conditions selected when the flaw is chosen, the effect has its ranks reduced with regard to its influence or resistance check DC by an amount equal to the flaw's rank.

flaws.name: Fast Return
flaws.summary: One additional lost point returns per round at the end of the target's turn per rank of this flaw.

flaws.name: Gallant
flaws.summary: Adding this flaw requires the character to spend a hero point to use the effect.

flaws.name: Immobile
flaws.summary: The power may only be activated while the character is stationary.

flaws.name: Inexact
flaws.summary: An Area effect with an Inexact flaw requires making a separate attack check (or power check, if appropriate) for every qualified target in the area of effect.

flaws.name: Momentum-Based
flaws.summary: This flaw may be applied to any non-Movement effect, making it reliant upon a Movement effect the character also possesses.

flaws.name: Nonlethal
flaws.summary: The effect is incapable of inflicting a dying or dead condition unless harm is inflicted as the result of a critical hit.

flaws.name: Obvious
flaws.summary: Obvious effects are more noticeable.

flaws.name: Prone
flaws.summary: You may be knocked prone (or set tumbling through the air if in flight, spinning through the water if swimming, and so on) upon activating the effect.

flaws.name: Push Over
flaws.summary: You are ill-prepared to prevent yourself from being knocked over by a solid blow.

flaws.name: Source
flaws.summary: The effect only works when you have access to a particular source to draw upon to activate and manifest the effect.

flaws.name: Strained
flaws.summary: An effect with this flaw cannot make use of or benefit from extra effort (or exceptional extra effort; see Better Mousetrap 3e).

flaws.name: Uncertain
flaws.summary: Increase your critical miss range with a particular attack (chosen when you acquire this flaw) by 1, resulting in a critical miss on a natural 1 or 2.

flaws.name: Weak Limbed
flaws.summary: When applied to Extra Limbs, your extra manipulative limbs have 1 rank of Strength less than your primary limbs per rank of this flaw.

style_extras.name: Aggressive
style_extras.summary: +1 to attack with all style combat maneuvers, but no Defensive Attack advantage or active Defend action.

style_extras.name: Attack Focus
style_extras.summary: +2 to attack and initiative with a named group of attacks used from a non-Neutral stance, and no extra critical miss chance.

style_extras.name: Defensive
style_extras.summary: +1 to Parry and Dodge while in a non-Neutral stance, but no All-Out Attack advantage or Charge action.

style_extras.name: Divine
style_extras.summary: A divine power grants an appropriate Feature per rank to the practitioner or their maneuvers.

style_extras.name: Esoteric
style_extras.summary: Obscure style: opponents who do not know it take -2 (1 rank) or -5 (2 ranks) on identify stance, disrupt stance and read opponent checks.

style_extras.name: Fixed
style_extras.summary: +2 Parry or Dodge in a round the practitioner moves no more than 5 feet; a second rank covers the other defense.

style_extras.name: Geomantic
style_extras.summary: With both feet planted, a Fighting Style check against an impact attack lowers its effect rank by the degrees of success.

style_extras.name: Metahuman
style_extras.summary: +2 to power checks for powers and power-based maneuvers related to the style.

style_extras.name: Mobile
style_extras.summary: +2 Parry or Dodge in a round the practitioner has moved more than 15 feet; a second rank covers the other defense.

style_extras.name: Mystic
style_extras.summary: With a Fighting Style check and an Expertise: Magic check, a maneuver's Strength-based damage can use the rank of a magic power.

style_extras.name: Spiritual
style_extras.summary: Use Will instead of Fortitude for resistance checks (failure by one degree dazes, two stuns, three incapacitates); Fighting Style replaces Awareness for trance advantages.

style_flaws.name: Clumsy Attacks
style_flaws.summary: -2 to attack and initiative with a named group or type of attacks used from a non-Neutral stance.

style_flaws.name: Demanding
style_flaws.summary: Weekly practice required (1 rank 7 hours, 2 ranks 14 hours, 3 ranks 28 hours) or suffer a growing penalty; an extra rank per additional -1 penalty.

style_flaws.name: Ill-Favored Conditions
style_flaws.summary: A named circumstance (outnumbered, drunk, cornered) costs -1 to attack, Parry or Dodge, or -2 to another combat check, per rank.

style_flaws.name: Impractical
style_flaws.summary: A natural 1 reveals the style's impracticality: a penalty equal to the rank to all style checks for one round.

style_flaws.name: Listless
style_flaws.summary: -4 to initiative per rank while using the style.

style_flaws.name: No Nonsense
style_flaws.summary: -2 to Expertise: Martial Showman checks per rank; no Showboating maneuver.

style_flaws.name: Predictable
style_flaws.summary: Opponents get +2 per rank to read opponent, identify stance and disrupt stance checks against the practitioner.

style_flaws.name: Slow
style_flaws.summary: Maximum speed reduced by one rank per rank while using the style.

style_flaws.name: Style Weakness
style_flaws.summary: -1 to Dodge and Parry against attacks from a chosen opposing fighting style.

style_flaws.name: Weak Defense
style_flaws.summary: -1 per rank to Parry or Dodge while using the style; cannot be combined with the Defensive extra.

style_flaws.name: Weapon Dependent
style_flaws.summary: All style maneuvers need a real weapon element; unarmed is never a weapon element of the style.
